answer: Each identity is tied to a warm-up in elapsed time. A newcomer keeps a small ember of stake burning for several epochs before its answers reach the panel; letting that ember go out restarts the clock. With a serialized queue, ten thousand keys advance no faster than one patient worker. Each identity must also leave a visible karst of past work, the eroded record of tasks it finished, and any gap is public. A reef of independent reviewers must vouch for the first submission before payout, so farms pay attention per head. Open registration still means marginal cost rises per extra identity.
